fusions.name: Blood in the Water
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. A tearing bite that deals 9 blood damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Frenzied Circuit
fusions.desc: Circles in a frenzy, dealing 30 blood damage to every enemy within 4 tiles and ignoring their resistances. It leaves them [Bleeding] for 6 seconds. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Gulped Down
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you, with a 10% critical chance. Its healing rises +8% for every tenth of your health already gone (max +40%).

fusions.name: Smell of Blood
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 25% of all damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
